boundary_map.fact: entered=true precedes libc close. Native raw and immediate valid errno are stored before returned=true. returned marks captured native outcome, not return from of_finish_native, of_leaf_close or the provider.

UNKNOWN_ENTERED is stored even before leaf entry. A stop in that interval leaves conservative unknown custody without proving libc dispatch. Returned zero becomes CLOSED_RETURNED; returned error becomes UNKNOWN_AFTER_CLOSE_RETURN.
Callback prepared-return, supplied value, engine raw/receipt and immutable public completion remain distinct. C2 completes an OPEN failure while actual held resource obligation survives.

Precleanup report and independent successful raw identity are copied before external cleanup. Frozen HeldUnvalidated cannot replace later cleanup outcome. complete is a serial validity marker, not atomic publication.

One request is recorded. Only known held custody permits its sole native close. Boolean true means protocol progression; ineligible and omitted paths can return true without native close. No failure or missing return permits retry.

Enclosing report includes post-cleanup result only after ordinary helper return. pwrite is later still. Full captured native return or cleanup call may precede an export failure. A missing envelope cannot identify which earlier stage stopped.

waitpid must identify child and WIFEXITED; then status is stored and exit0 required. Signaled status is not copied into child_status. Exact fstat size/pread, version, selector, count bounds and fd bindings precede report_valid.

report_valid means structural envelope availability only. Raw identity/veto, absent accepted creation, observer/conversion/setup and expected-result checks are later. main may assess after a later supervisor failure. Policy-control failure is separately reported; it is not automatically a malformed envelope.

Parent uses its own capabilities and independent raw identity; child numeric descriptor is only reported evidence, never a parent handle. Empty file observation and observer close acknowledge only parent operations.

Checked fixed-name unlink, empty-directory removal and parent descriptor closes are separate acknowledgements. They neither prove child close nor persistence, durability, recovery or absence of earlier interruption.

disposition_map.prohibited: No follow-up provider I/O from HeldUnvalidated; no second request, no parent use of saved child fd.

evidence_basis.first_matrix: Retained GCC 7.5 Linux AArch64 C11 first matrix; no replay. 14 fresh exec children historically, four candidate selectors and three singleton controls per mode; 32 summed candidate assertions/8 distinct names per mode.
evidence_basis.historical_outcomes: All 14 successful opens fd3; all 42 provider queries zero; all 12 actual external closes zero. Two omission controls contain no close dispatch. These are retained results, not newly executed cases.
evidence_basis.unexecuted: No actual close/query error, fd0, missing return, failed export/cleanup, abnormal termination or report rejection was exercised by that matrix.

findings.text: An entered marker is conservative intent before a libc call. UnknownEntered is earlier still. Neither proves a native operation actually ran.
The returned flag is captured native result validity. It is set before ordinary C helper/leaf return. Partial raw/error stores without it are incomplete and cannot be consumed as a result.
The frozen precleanup HeldUnvalidated state is intentionally stale after external close. Public ActiveIncomplete has no payload and conveys no native cleanup disposition.
The C2 normalized OPEN-failure completion proves neither native open failure nor removal of the held cleanup obligation. All 33-byte ID and full-width identity copies stay separate.

The two C3 omission controls record requested/eligible but attempted=false, entered=false and returned=false, with zero raw/error and unchanged held state. They are non-dispatch controls; they provide no missing-return observation.
Existing shared cleanup_truthful rejects actual returned error; it accepts only returned-zero or honest omission. The new review does not loosen that witness oracle to accept untested native error.

A captured native outcome, provider custody transition, cleanup out-copy and child pwrite have distinct boundaries. An absent downstream report cannot disambiguate any of them; a completed write may also fail later acceptance.

Structural report_valid precedes raw identity and later observer/oracle checks. It must not be described as whole-run acceptance. A valid control report may truthfully contain a failed policy composite.
Parent post-exit observation/unlink can succeed in both normal-close and omission controls, so those acknowledgements cannot discriminate child close dispatch or success.

KnownHeld eligibility refers to the ordinary local custodian before its one request. An accepted post-exit child report is historical evidence, never a live capability or permission to close the saved numeric fd.

minimal_inputs: Bounded inert resource label, local custody phase (HeldUnvalidated/VerifiedHeld/ArmedUnknown/UnknownAfterReturn/ClosedReturned), one-request status, leaf-entered marker, captured-return validity and authored raw/error pair.
Separate parent wait/envelope/provenance/semantic eligibility values and separately copied parent observation/cleanup acknowledgements. No actual report parser or transport is added.
future_boundary.name: ordinary close disposition value classifier
future_boundary.next_step: Separately scoped source-only plan must pin value schema, valid/invalid combinations, snapshot stage semantics, acceptance predicate, finite selectors/baselines and exact control composites before any implementation.
future_boundary.not_proven: Authored stopped values are not native missing returns, signal delivery, process termination, errno behavior or asynchronous state capture. No concurrency or native lifetime proof follows.
outputs: Local historical classification and one-cleanup eligibility value, never an executable permission.
Captured native return classification separate from provider/helper ordinary return acknowledgement.
Parent-visible child classification only when the explicitly planned acceptance predicate permits it; otherwise Unavailable without consuming child payload.
Parent operation acknowledgement values remain an independent product and never promote child close evidence.
required_cases: Known held/no request; known held/honest requested-but-omitted close; conservative ArmedUnknown before leaf entry; leaf entered/no complete capture; partial result stores without captured marker; captured zero before provider promotion; returned-zero with downstream report; captured -1 including authored EINTR sentinel; stale frozen-held plus later closed receipt; absent and structurally valid but semantically refused report; independent parent cleanup success with child omission/unknown; malformed contradictory value combinations.
required_refusals: Unknown enum/invalid domain or contradictory complete receipt combinations return InvalidEvidence with no eligibility.
No false native-zero from zero defaults; no error-to-held transition; no reset/reopen/retry.

Report availability, provenance and expected witness verdict are distinct fields; a control verdict alone does not erase an otherwise truthful accepted report. Exact predicate and no-payload-read behavior require the later plan.
No scope leakage into legacy engine/provider/report ABI. Frozen sole admission/completion and five setup APIs remain untouched.
future_boundary.scope: An inert, total value-only classifier of authored local receipt stages plus a separate parent report-acceptance projection. No descriptor, address, native function pointer, provider callback, syscall dispatcher or external resource capability is accepted or returned.
future_boundary.status: selected-for-separate-source-only-plan; no implementation or executed cases

limits: All prior frozen bytes, failures, quarantine and protections remain unchanged; every live gate CLOSED.

No native frame/crash-file provider, CM_BLAME/CM_CRASHES/startup/quarantine operation, callback nesting/concurrency, DSO/installer, signal/nonlocal exit, firmware/emulator/device, production/live composition or release.
LL/SC retry, libc/canary/sanitizer dependencies, arbitrary DSO/slot/callback custody, nonparticipating writers, loader/interposition, native visibility, quiescence and recovery remain unresolved.
Ownership is not fault causation. No durability, persistence or recovery claim. No new process count or runtime assertion count follows from proposed cases or controls.

non_execution.note: Only local source/evidence reads, new review retention and independent byte audit are in scope.

proposed_controls.baseline: Same value is Unknown, captured-result unavailable, no cleanup eligibility.
proposed_controls.mutation: Only replace captured-return-required zero classification with raw==0 classification for an authored entered/no captured-return value whose raw storage is zero.
proposed_controls.owned_consequences: False zero acknowledgement and every derived completed-close classification are checked here; shared input/provenance checks remain unchanged.
proposed_controls.safety: Inert values only, no real close.

proposed_controls.baseline: Returned error remains unknown and ineligible, with captured error preserved.
proposed_controls.mutation: Only map a valid authored returned -1/error receipt to held/cleanup-eligible instead of UnknownAfterReturn.
proposed_controls.owned_consequences: Incorrect held class and derived eligibility are owned here; raw/error truth is separately preserved.
proposed_controls.safety: No error injection into libc; no syscall dispatcher.

proposed_controls.baseline: Parent child outcome Unavailable; no child payload consumption; independent parent facts unchanged.
proposed_controls.mutation: Only bypass the one planned parent evidence-acceptance veto for an explicitly unaccepted report carrying an otherwise valid authored closed-zero payload.
proposed_controls.owned_consequences: Payload-consumption counter/value and falsely exposed child classification belong here, avoiding a hidden duplicate veto.
proposed_controls.safety: Authored inert input only; no actual failed export, callback or terminated child.

proposed_controls.baseline: Parent cleanup acknowledged independently; child remains non-dispatch and has no captured close result.
proposed_controls.mutation: Only promote child close acknowledgement when an independent authored parent unlink acknowledgement is true, while accepted child evidence records honest non-dispatch.
proposed_controls.owned_consequences: False child acknowledgement and any projected close class belong here; parent operation facts remain identical.
proposed_controls.safety: No file or parent process operations.

proposed_controls.baseline: Explicit NonDispatch with unchanged held historical obligation; not a missing-return class.
proposed_controls.mutation: Only relabel requested/eligible but unattempted/unentered/unreturned held evidence as entered-with-missing-return.
proposed_controls.owned_consequences: Misclassification and any derived unknown/eligibility label belong here; raw fields stay truthful and shared malformed-input refusal stays active.
proposed_controls.safety: No actual interruption; finite authored values only.
